facts.text: Larry Burge designed and Lynn Howard created the Little Free Library that opened in Sulphur Springs City Park on June 9, 2026.
The Sulphur Springs Farmers Market opens on May 2nd, featuring homemade and homegrown goods from local vendors.
The 2026 Sulphur Nights Festival celebrated under the stars, thanks to community members who made it a huge success.
On August 8, 2026, the Arkansas Department of Health lifted the boil order for Sulphur Springs Waterworks, allowing normal water use.
Sulphur Springs values guided growth and preservation of historical, cultural, and natural heritage, making it a wonderful place to call home.
Sulphur Springs moved its annual city celebration to cooler afternoon and evening hours in 2026, replacing the all-day summer event.
